wiki.title: Romaine Quinn
wiki.extract: Romaine Robert Quinn (born July 30, 1990) is an American Republican politician from Birchwood, Wisconsin. He is member of the Wisconsin State Senate, representing the 25th Senate district since January 2023. He was previously mayor of Rice Lake and served three terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly (2015–2021) representing the 75th Assembly district.
